name: Aisel Teymurzadeh
description: Azerbaijani pop singer known for representing Azerbaijan at Eurovision 2009 with 'Always'. She blends pop, R&B, and traditional Azerbaijani elements in her music.
biography:
Aysel Teymurzadeh rose to fame after competing in the 2009 Eurovision Song Contest, where her powerful vocals captured international attention. Born in Baku, she started her career in the early 2000s, releasing hits that mix modern pop with Azerbaijani folk influences. Aysel has since become a staple in Azerbaijani music, performing at major festivals and collaborating with global artists.

Her Eurovision participation marked a breakthrough, leading to albums and tours across Europe. She advocates for women's rights and cultural preservation through her music. Today, Aysel continues to inspire with her energetic performances and social media presence, maintaining a loyal fanbase in Azerbaijan and abroad.

Beyond the stage, she mentors young singers and engages in philanthropy, focusing on education in rural areas.

name: Roya
description: Prominent Azerbaijani pop singer known for her liberal style and collaborations with Turkish labels. Winner of the Altın Kelebek award.
biography:
Röya, born Roya Yagub gyzy Najafova in Baku, has captivated audiences with her bold pop anthems since the early 2000s. Her music often explores themes of love and empowerment, blending Azerbaijani melodies with contemporary beats. Röya's breakthrough came with hits like 'Sənə qurban', earning her widespread acclaim in Azerbaijan and Turkey.

She has released multiple albums and performed at international festivals, solidifying her status as a regional icon. Röya is also known for her advocacy in women's fashion and music education. Her engaging social media content keeps fans connected to her creative process.

In recent years, she has ventured into acting and producing, expanding her influence in the entertainment industry.

name: Aygun Kazimova
description: Versatile Azerbaijani artist excelling in pop, mugam, and opera. Known for performances in Azerbaijan, Turkey, and Russia.
biography:
Aygün Kazimova, a Baku native, began her career as a child prodigy in traditional mugam singing before transitioning to pop stardom. Her powerful voice has graced stages worldwide, earning her the title of People's Artist of Azerbaijan. Aygün's discography includes hits that fuse classical Azerbaijani sounds with modern genres.

She has acted in films and TV shows, broadening her appeal. A passionate educator, she teaches vocal techniques to aspiring artists. Her resilience in the competitive music scene makes her a role model.

In 2025, Aygün continues to release music and collaborate, maintaining her relevance through innovative projects.

name: Alim Qasimov
description: Legendary Azerbaijani mugam master, UNESCO-recognized intangible cultural heritage performer. Known for innovative fusions.
biography:
Alim Qasimov, born in Shamakhi, revolutionized traditional mugam singing with his emotive and improvisational style. Trained under masters, he gained global fame through collaborations with Western artists like Jeff Buckley. His performances preserve Azerbaijani heritage while pushing boundaries.

A teacher at the Baku Music Academy, he has influenced generations. Awards include the IMC/UNESCO Music Prize. Alim's family, including daughter Fidan, continues the legacy.

His 2025 recordings blend mugam with jazz, attracting younger audiences worldwide.

name: Polad Bulbuloglu
description: Iconic Azerbaijani singer blending jazz and folk, former Minister of Culture. Soviet-era superstar.
biography:
Polad Bulbuloglu, son of opera singer Bulbul, emerged in the 1960s with jazz-infused Azerbaijani songs that became Soviet hits. His compositions won three 'Song of the Year' awards. Transitioning to politics, he served as Deputy Minister of Culture.

His diplomatic roles include Ambassador to Russia. Polad's music library exceeds 300 songs, performed globally. He promotes cultural ties between nations.

In 2025, he mentors young composers, ensuring his legacy endures.

name: Samira Efendi
description: Rising Azerbaijani pop star who represented her country at Eurovision 2021 with 'Mata Hari'. Known for versatile genres.
biography:
Samira Efendi, from Baku, started as a child singer before hitting stardom with pop tracks incorporating traditional elements. Her Eurovision entry showcased dramatic vocals and storytelling. She has released albums blending pop and Azerbaijani folk.

Active in philanthropy, she supports music education for underprivileged youth. Samira's dynamic stage presence has earned her international tours.

By 2025, she dominates charts and social media, collaborating with regional artists.

name: Emin Agalarov
description: Azerbaijani-Russian pop singer and entrepreneur, People's Artist of Azerbaijan. Performs in multiple languages.
biography:
Emin Agalarov, son of billionaire Aras Agalarov, pursued music alongside business studies in Moscow. His debut album in 2006 launched a career with hits in English, Russian, and Azerbaijani. Named People's Artist in 2018.

He heads the Crocus Group while releasing music and touring. Emin supports cultural events like the Miss Universe pageant.

In 2025, his philanthropy focuses on youth arts programs.

name: Leyla Aliyeva
description: Daughter of the President, prominent Instagram influencer with 2.1M followers. Focuses on lifestyle and culture.
biography:
Leyla Aliyeva, vice-president of the Heydar Aliyev Foundation, uses her platform for philanthropy and cultural promotion. Her Instagram features fashion, travel, and Azerbaijani heritage. She supports arts and environmental causes.

Educated in London and Switzerland, Leyla blends global sophistication with national pride. Her influence extends to media production.

In 2025, she launches eco-initiatives via social media.

name: Anar Agakishiev
description: Celebrity makeup artist with 1.5M Instagram followers. Specializes in transformations and beauty tutorials.
biography:
Anar Agakishiev, based in Baku, built his career through viral before-and-after videos on Instagram and YouTube. Collaborating with models and influencers, he promotes Azerbaijani beauty standards globally. His tutorials blend traditional and modern techniques.

Anar has worked on TV shows and events, earning a spot among top influencers. He advocates for self-confidence.

By 2025, he expands into beauty product lines.

name: Nicat Azadli
description: Prominent dancer and event organizer with strong presence on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Specializes in wedding performances.
biography:
Nicat Azadli, from Baku, turned his passion for dance into a career managing events and promoting courses. His energetic videos showcase Azerbaijani dance traditions at celebrations. With a multi-platform following, he books dancers for global events.

Nicat's content highlights cultural fusion dances. He mentors young talents.

In 2025, he produces dance festivals.

name: Rashad Sadygov
description: Azerbaijan's most capped player with 110 international appearances. Defender for national team and clubs.
biography:
Rashad Sadygov debuted for Azerbaijan in 2001, becoming the record holder for caps. He played for Neftchi Baku and international clubs, contributing to key matches. Post-retirement, he coaches youth teams.

Known for leadership, he captained the national side. Rashad promotes football development in Azerbaijan.

In 2025, he analyzes games for media.

name: Gurban Gurbanov
description: Azerbaijan's all-time top scorer with 12 international goals. Now manager of Qarabag FK.
biography:
Gurban Gurbanov scored 12 goals in 66 caps for Azerbaijan, playing for top clubs like Hapoel Tel Aviv. His career highlights include European competitions. As coach, he led Qarabag to UEFA successes.

He develops young talents and promotes Azerbaijani football.

In 2025, his team contends for titles.

name: Teimour Radjabov
description: Former chess prodigy, world-ranked player. Known for victories over Kasparov.
biography:
Teimour Radjabov earned Grandmaster title at 14, the second-youngest ever. He defeated Kasparov in 2003 and competed in World Championships. Representing Azerbaijan, he won team golds.

An advocate for chess education, he participates in exhibitions.

In 2025, he remains top-ranked.

name: Shakhriyar Mamedyarov
description: Two-time World Junior Champion, consistently top-10 worldwide. Azerbaijani chess star.
biography:
Shakhriyar Mamedyarov, from Sumqayit, won junior titles and reached Elo 2820. He excels in rapid and classical formats, contributing to team successes.

He promotes chess in schools and writes columns.

In 2025, he challenges for titles.

name: Farid Mansurov
description: Olympic gold medalist in freestyle wrestling at 2008 Beijing. Multiple world champion.
biography:
Farid Mansurov dominated the 60kg category, winning Olympic gold and world titles. From Baku, he trained rigorously to represent Azerbaijan internationally.

Post-retirement, he coaches and runs wrestling academies.

In 2025, he mentors Olympians.

name: Mariya Stadnik
description: Four-time Olympic medalist in women's freestyle wrestling. Azerbaijani-Ukrainian athlete.
biography:
Mariya Stadnik, born in Ukraine but representing Azerbaijan since 2004, won silvers and bronzes at Olympics. Her technical prowess defines the sport.

She advocates for women's wrestling and trains in Baku.

In 2025, she aims for Paris gold.

name: Ramil Guliyev
description: World 200m champion representing Azerbaijan and Turkey. Azerbaijani-born track star.
biography:
Ramil Guliyev, born in Baku, won the 2018 World 200m gold for Turkey but holds Azerbaijani roots. He set national records and competed in Olympics.

His speed inspired Azerbaijani athletics.

In 2025, he coaches sprinters.

name: Aygun Babayeva
description: Baku-based belly dancer with viral TikTok and Instagram content. Promotes cultural events.
biography:
Aygun Babayeva captivates with belly dance performances tied to Azerbaijani weddings and festivals. Her social media features tutorials and live shows, building a dedicated following.

She organizes dance workshops and collaborates on cultural projects.

In 2025, she expands online courses.

name: Naz Dej
description: TikTok and Instagram star sharing music and lifestyle content. Emerging Azerbaijani talent.
biography:
Naz Dej gained fame through catchy music clips on TikTok, amassing followers with relatable lyrics. From Baku, she blends pop with personal stories in her posts.

She releases singles and engages fans via live sessions.

In 2025, she signs major label deal.

name: Nadjiba Ahmedi
description: Vibrant lifestyle and beauty vlogger on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Engages with fashion and daily life.
biography:
Nadjiba Ahmedi creates engaging videos on beauty routines and Azerbaijani lifestyle, drawing a young audience. Based in Baku, her content features collaborations and tips.

She promotes local brands and self-care.

In 2025, she launches a beauty line.
